answer: Because the sonnet weight is recomputed from the trellis history each close, the oasis audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 10 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 36% of full weight. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for each alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 16 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
